title: K-Bench: A Benchmark for LLM Unlearning in Agentic Deployments
abstract: arXiv:2609.12808v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Unlearning benchmarks such as TOFU and MUSE certify forgetting by reading the model's final answer, where a model that refuses to answer already counts as having forgotten. We show that this model-level certificate does not transfer once the model is deployed as an agent. We introduce K-Bench, a benchmark that scores LLM unlearning under agentic deployment. K-Bench inspects all six channels a ReAct agent exposes, including its chain-of-thought (CoT), tool calls and tool observations, and elicited summary. A query counts as leaked if the secret appears in any of them. Each experiment places the secret in exactly one of the agent's three sources (the weights, the prompt, or the retrieval store). The K-Score is computed separately for each source and credits forgetting only when the agent remains usable. Clearing the answer channel does not make the secret unrecoverable. On structured retrieval, the secret stays verbatim in the tool-obs

translated_title: K-Bench：面向智能体部署场景的大语言模型遗忘基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.12808v2 公告类型：替换。诸如TOFU和MUSE等遗忘基准通过阅读模型的最终答案来验证遗忘效果，在这种评估方式下，拒绝回答的模型即已被视为“遗忘”。我们证明，这种模型层面的认证一旦模型被部署为智能体便不再成立。我们提出了K-Bench，一个在智能体部署场景下评估大语言模型遗忘效果的基准测试。K-Bench检查ReAct智能体暴露的全部六个通道，包括其思维链、工具调用与工具观测结果，以及引导生成的总结。只要秘密信息出现在其中任何一个通道，该查询即被判定为泄露。每个实验将秘密信息恰好置于智能体的三个信息来源之一（模型权重、提示词或检索库）中。K-Score针对每个信息来源分别计算，且仅在智能体遗忘后仍保持可用性的前提下才计入遗忘得分。仅清除答案通道并不能使秘密信息无法被恢复。在结构化检索场景中，秘密信息会以原文形式保留在工具观测结果中……
tldr: 现有遗忘基准仅凭模型最终答案来判定遗忘是否成功，而K-Bench揭示了在智能体部署场景下秘密信息仍可通过思维链、工具调用与观测等六个通道泄露，并提出了一个针对权重、提示词、检索库三种信息来源、且要求智能体在遗忘后保持可用性的新评估基准。
en_tdlr: K-Bench shows that unlearning certificates based on a model's final answer do not transfer to agentic deployments, and introduces a benchmark that evaluates LLM unlearning across all six channels exposed by a ReAct agent, scoring each secret source (weights, prompt, retrieval store) while requiring the agent to remain usable.
